inputs.utterance: Categorize customers based into groups of (0–12 months, 1–2 years, 2–3 years, 3–4 years, and 4–5 years) based on how long ago they made their first order

calculatedFieldFormula.formula: IF DATEDIFF('month', { FIXED [CustomerID] : MIN([Order Placed Date]) }, TODAY()) <= 12 THEN '0–12 months' ELSEIF DATEDIFF('month', { FIXED [CustomerID] : MIN([Order Placed Date]) }, TODAY()) <= 24 THEN '1–2 years' ELSEIF DATEDIFF('month', { FIXED [CustomerID] : MIN([Order Placed Date]) }, TODAY()) <= 36 THEN '2–3 years' ELSEIF DATEDIFF('month', { FIXED [CustomerID] : MIN([Order Placed Date]) }, TODAY()) <= 48 THEN '3–4 years' ELSEIF DATEDIFF('month', { FIXED [CustomerID] : MIN([Order Placed Date]) }, TODAY()) <= 60 THEN '4–5 years' END
